clips.title: The story
paras: Lago Blackwrench sends Gakin's Summons from Ironforge to promising Alliance warlocks. It directs them south to Stormwind, where Gakin the Darkbinder awaits beneath the Mage Quarter to oversee their advancement in commanding greater fiends.

Demonology remains hidden across Alliance lands. In Ironforge, Lago Blackwrench quietly watches wandering practitioners for the brotherhood in Stormwind. When a warlock shows mastery over their first minions, word travels quickly. Lago passes along the directive: leave your business in the snowy mountains of Khaz Modan and report south without delay.

Gakin the Darkbinder coordinates Stormwind's warlocks beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in the city's Mage Quarter. He sees every capable student as a valuable, hazardous investment. His summons marks the threshold of true demonic binding, beginning the trials to subjugate a succubus from the Twisting Nether.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend! Didn't expect to see you around these parts, but I was instructed to keep an eye out for you.
It's past time you got some more training, so you should stop in to see Gakin the next time you're in Stormwind. He'll be waiting for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, friend. I was beginning to fear the worst. It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you.
We can talk later, though. Your training is the only important thing now.
